text: 9月9日，财政部副部长廖岷在北京会见新加坡金融管理局副行长梁新松，双方就全球及两国宏观经济形势和两国财金合作等问题交换了意见。
text_en: On September 9, Vice Minister of Finance Liao Min met in Beijing with Leong Sin Soon, Deputy Managing Director of the Monetary Authority of Singapore, and the two sides exchanged views on the global and bilateral macroeconomic situation and bilateral financial cooperation, among other issues.
